CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS lead_processing_state (
  email_key text PRIMARY KEY,
  raw_payload jsonb NOT NULL,
  operational_priority text NOT NULL CHECK (operational_priority IN ('high', 'normal', 'low')),
  state text NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('pending', 'retryable', 'manual_review', 'permanent_failure', 'completed')),
  stage text NOT NULL CHECK (stage IN ('ollama', 'hubspot', 'whatsapp', 'completed')),
  ollama_status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  hubspot_status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  hubspot_contact_id text,
  attempt_count integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  next_retry_at timestamptz,
  lease_until timestamptz,
  failure_class text,
  failure_code text,
  failure_message text,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS whatsapp_delivery_state (
  email_key text PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES lead_processing_state(email_key),
  status text NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'retryable', 'accepted', 'permanent_failure', 'manual_review')),
  attempt_count integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  next_retry_at timestamptz,
  lease_until timestamptz,
  last_http_status integer,
  last_error_class text,
  last_error_code text,
  last_error_message text,
  meta_message_id text,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
